notes: Stats are net of the per-trade spread (R - cost), trades of DEF_KEYS setups only (scalp, rscalp, intraday, rintra, swing, position, rswing, m30m1), portfolio limits ignored.
Evaluation starts after a 30-day warm-up; IS = first 2/3 of the evaluation window, OOS = last 1/3. "years" holds calendar months (the stream is 150 days).

Every learner trades a subset of a stream that loses ~-0.19R a trade, so total R mostly measures how much a variant stops trading. Per-trade expectancy against random thinning (randomThinning.pct = share of 300 random same-size subsets it beats) is the selection test.
F1 (frozen, picked on IS with n>=30, t>=2, both halves) selected no rule at all, so it equals F0.
Not simulated: minRisk/buf (stop width), review lessons (hunt/noise/late/news), dollar cap/exposure, market pauses, second target and market entry.

data.verdict: REAL, but not where it was suspected. CNBC intraday candles never jump at a roll (one contract per request), so no H1 gap / FVG / sweep and no replay exit was faked by a roll step. Three data problems are real: (1) the DAILY candles step by the calendar spread at every switch (5-7x the 95th-percentile H1 gap) and flipped the 50-day bias of 8 replay A-signals; (2) live, a trade open across a switch is managed against candles one spread away (1 replay A-trade, gold 29 Jul 2026, +1.07R of fake gain); (3) the replay used the current contract own history from before it was front: thin deferred prints (H1 ranges 0-0.8x the market, up to 100 % one-print candles) behind 90 of the 249 replay A-trades, incl. the 4 Jun 2026 NQ/ES signals.

topics.headline: the shadow book's −300R week is 100% costs, not trading.

data.verdict: The shadow book did not lose −287.94R of trading: on 515 closed shadow trades it made +92.55R gross and paid 380.49R of modelled costs, 82% of them Kraken spot fees on 139 crypto scalps whose stops are a fraction of the 0.8% round trip (the same trades at CFD cost: +18.17R). One bookkeeping artefact is proven and repaired (29 m30m1 copies of Scalp entries, 26 closed this week, counted twice: after the repair the week is 489 trades, +73.74R gross / −303.77R net). The near-stop market fills are a sizing artefact for the owner to rule on (23 trades filled at under half the planned risk carry 85.92R of the cost). No shadow stream has robust research behind it; rscalp and the crypto legs are already judged (losing / unjudgeable on this venue) and should be retired; intraday, rintra on gold, m30m1 on its own trades and the ICT variants are the streams worth the paper.
